affectedCopies: Decision log / decision record drill-in read model (DecisionInteraction sources + chain columns)

migration.name: 20260806021500_trust_envelope_decision_records
migration.backfill: additive only, no backfill required. Four NEW nullable columns on DecisionInteraction (chainId, prevHash, chainEntryHash, sealedAt): every pre-existing row is left with NULL and reads as 'unsealed', which is a valid state, never invalid. The UNIQUE index on chainEntryHash is data-safe because Postgres treats NULLs as distinct, so existing all-NULL rows cannot collide (attested in the migration with @migration-safety: data-safe). Three NEW tables (EvidenceReVerification, JurisdictionCriteriaProfile, ProtectedMonitoringObservation) hold no rows at migration time. No rows deleted, no column dropped, no value overwritten. Applies cleanly against any existing data state.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: every existing DecisionInteraction row is retained unchanged; sealed rows become append-only (a write guard forbids mutating sealed fields once sealedAt is set). Sealing is fail-open, so a row that cannot be sealed is simply left unsealed, never lost.

fields.reason: tamper-evidence: a recorded decision is sealed into an append-only per-(profile) hash chain so any post-hoc edit is detectable (BI-81CC5D8E, spec §2 Axis 3). Nullable + unique; NULL on legacy rows, distinct sha256 on sealed rows.
links each sealed decision to the prior chain entry so the chain can be verified end-to-end and a broken link is detectable.

evidence grounding (BI-EA97E5CD, spec §2 Axis 1): the previously-empty sources column now carries the admissible per-(option,dimension) citations that back the scored features. Populated only on the kernel-consult path going forward; legacy rows keep their existing (empty) value.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: new table; rows are created and removed with their parent DecisionInteraction via cascade (domain-lifecycle-managed exemption). Append-only by convention (no updatedAt).

fields.reason: records an independent re-check verdict (confirmed | degraded | unresolved) of one cited evidence item against its live source (BI-70FF9114, spec §2 Axis 4).
fields.provenance: spec §2 Axis 4; evidence-reverifier.test.ts. Classification: confidential (may quote decision/candidate source text).

changes.lifecycleDisposition: new table; operator-authored jurisdiction criteria packs, versioned and superseded (reference-data exemption). Classification: internal (config, no PII).

fields.reason: selects which scoring axes apply and how they are weighted per (industry, jurisdiction, activityClass) regime (BI-B84CD2D3, spec §2 Axis 2). Keyed on the same tuple as RegulatoryAutonomyPolicy so the autonomy ceiling and axis profile never disagree.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: new table; MONITORING-ONLY demographic rail, structurally separate from the scoring path (no scoring foreign key — joined only by an opaque evaluationRef). Retained as LL144/EEOC bias-audit evidence (RETAINED_DATASETS, min 1 year), never auto-purged within the audit window. Classification: confidential (protected-class PII — obfuscate before any copy).

fields.reason: protected-class observations collected (where lawful + consented) SOLELY to compute NYC LL144 / four-fifths adverse-impact ratios; the scoring path holds no read access to this table (BI-A59CB2EA, spec §6.3). The thing measured for a bias audit is the thing that must never touch the score, so it shares no FK with the score.
